acceptance: Record a root-owned finite event/reference matrix for session.lifecycle, delegation.lifecycle, subprocess.launch, worker.lifecycle, subprocess.exit, and subprocess.handoff, identifying delegating-session-reference, child-session-reference, or absent outcomes and their availability timing.

Define that only valid opaque session IDs may be emitted; unavailable references remain absent and never become paths, generated guesses, store references, prompts, tool content, provider/runtime payloads, or authorization.

Map current ownership, consumers, baseline tests, and separate follow-up gates for launcher lifecycle production, observability projection, and evidence-tool correlation without implementing those follow-ups in this phase.

Preserve task-record authority, routing, configured worker identity, expert gates, front-matter skill forwarding compatibility, emitted-path privacy, runtime semantics, and host-neutral boundaries; no runtime, launcher, observability, evidence-tool, task-protocol, capability, host, or target behavior changes.

Validate the contract/matrix handoff with task-record, backlog/schema, content/navigation, JSON/reference, whitespace, and diff checks plus fresh read-only expert review; no descendants are required for this planning phase.
